Messages.Author: Josh Hsu
Messages.Body:
Anyone understand how undead persistence works? (the normal version only)
Basically, I'm asking for an official translation b/c the way its worded now
is kinda dubious.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Undead Persistence (normal) is only usable when the vampire would
be sent to torpor during combat and...

-> Prevents the vampire from going to torpor
-> For the rest of the combat, prevents the vampire from going to torpor
at all if no card has been played within the 3 rounds prior to
it being sent to torpor
-> Gives one optional press

The "or within 3 rounds" part is mainly useful if Trap was played at
the beginning of the combat. Otherwise, you have to keep playing presses
to keep continuing the combat.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Josh Hsu <jo...@merle.acns.nwu.edu> wrote:
>>-> For the rest of the combat, prevents the vampire from going to torpor
>> at all if no card has been played within the 3 rounds prior to
>> it being sent to torpor
>Could you explain this more clearly? I'm still confused as to what this
>means...

It means that if the vampire is sent to torpor again, it looks to see if
any cards (including Undead Persistence) have been used in the last
three rounds, and if so, the vampire does not go to torpor. This is just
like Trap checking to see if cards have been played.

>>-> Gives one optional press
>Also, what happens if the said minion does aggravated damage(ie basilia).
>if the vampire has 0 blood counters on it, and basilia hits it, it will goto
>torpor. If that vampire then uses undead persistence, will basilia's next hit
>burn it or will it have basically no effect?

Aggravated damage will only burn a vampire outright if it does more than
one damage in a single shot. The Persisting vampire will ignore 1-point
aggravated strikes just as it would ignore 1-point normal strikes. I believe
a multidamage aggravated strike would still burn the vampire outright
in spite of Undead Persistence, but will double check that.
